tasks.goal: Greet the receptionist and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.

tasks.goal: State your appointment time and doctor name
tasks.hint: Provide your check-in details to the receptionist.

tasks.goal: Present insurance card and photo identification
tasks.hint: Offer your paperwork for identity verification.
tasks.done_when: Learner presented insurance card or identification.

tasks.goal: Inquire about current estimated wait time before consultation
tasks.hint: Ask if the doctor is running on schedule.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about expected wait time.

tasks.goal: Ask where to complete new patient intake forms
tasks.hint: Ask if paperwork should be filled out on paper or a tablet.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'appointment'

tasks.goal: Request an interpreter or language assistance

tasks.goal: Ask where the blood lab or radiology department is located

tasks.goal: Ask about copay payment requirements prior to seeing the doctor

tasks.goal: Confirm preferred phone number for lab test follow-up calls

tasks.goal: Confirm primary physician name and clinic department

tasks.goal: State whether this is a follow-up or first-time consultation

tasks.goal: Confirm location of clinic pharmacy for filling prescriptions
tasks.hint: Ask where to collect prescribed medications in facility.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'copayment'

tasks.goal: Use the word 'referral'
tasks.hint: Referral is official recommendation. Confirm specialist referral is on file.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'symptomatic'
tasks.hint: Symptomatic means showing signs of illness. State how long you have been symptomatic.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'physician'
tasks.hint: Physician refers to a qualified medical doctor. Inquire if an attending physician is available for a consultation.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification regarding out-of-network insurance coverage

tasks.goal: Inquire if lab test results will be posted on online portal

tasks.goal: Inquire about financial hardship payment plan options

tasks.goal: Report change of home address and billing details
